hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); pkg=$(echo "$f" | grep -oE '/(packages|apps)/[^/]+/src' | sed -E 's#/(packages|apps)/([^/]+)/src#\2#'); if [ -n "$pkg" ]; then cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; hit=$(grep -ril "$pkg" docs/implementation/specs/*.md 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$hit" ]; then reason="Nenhuma SPEC em docs/implementation/specs/ menciona '$pkg'. Confirme que existe uma SPEC aprovada cobrindo esta mudanca (use a skill spec-check) antes de prosseguir."; jq -n --arg reason "$reason" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}'; exit 0; fi; fi; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '/(packages|apps)/[^/]+/src/.*\.ts$'; then cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; lint_out=$(pnpm exec eslint "$f" 2>&1); lint_rc=$?; tsc_out=$(pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit 2>&1); tsc_rc=$?; if [ "$lint_rc" -ne 0 ] || [ "$tsc_rc" -ne 0 ]; then { [ "$lint_rc" -ne 0 ] && printf 'ESLint:
%s
' "$lint_out"; [ "$tsc_rc" -ne 0 ] && printf 'tsc:
%s
' "$tsc_out"; } >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0
